'''Spark jars''' were electrical devices that were part of the special fueling system for the [[StarSpeeder 3000]]s used by [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Three spark jars were located in the middle of the Maintenance Bay of Star Tours' [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="CGST" />

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1st}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
